name: LiteLights
description: Shadows, water, sky, fog and ambient effects that keep the vanilla look and stay fast. Credits: rendering ideas (cached shadow map, forward-shaded effects, biome atmosphere): idea by Shinyflvres (ImmersiveVFX), whose atmosphere effects were in turn inspired by Oreville Studios' Realistic Biomes. Large water textures: idea by Tec (Big Water). Vanilla-style water and lava textures by Tec, from Big Water, CC0-1.0. Jump splash: idea by Chai (Particular). Storm atmosphere (sandstorm fog, blizzards, swamp and pale garden fog, ambient wind, dark pale-garden rain): ideas by TheDeathlyCow (Immersive Storms). Weather on glass: glass weather idea by duffopuffo (Weather Glass). Rain drips and wall streaks: drip and streak ideas by pigcart (Particle Rain). Overlays module: draws through Continuity (Pepper_Bell). Recommended: LambDynamicLights and LambdaBetterGrass by LambdAurora.
